purpose: Prevent historical operations from auto-firing in Branch B. Historical chronology supplies candidate options and process anchors, not compulsory decisions.

required_gates.physical_capability: Required hulls/air units/crews are physically present or have a dated feasible movement chain and are serviceable enough for the mission.
required_gates.command_release: The owning command has actually released the assets; theater-local availability cannot silently debit Combined Fleet/mobile-fleet assets.
required_gates.operational_slack: Fuel, escorts, maintenance, trained crews, reconnaissance and recovery capacity remain after higher-priority commitments.
required_gates.motive_and_payoff: The expected military or political payoff is still worth the risk in the Branch situation; historical motive may have weakened or strengthened.
required_gates.information_quality: For target-dependent sorties, the command has enough current information to justify launch; theoretical radius is not a target solution.
required_gates.opportunity_cost: The force is not more valuable in another active or imminent theater unless command explicitly accepts that tradeoff.

decision_rule: If any major gate fails, default DELAY/HOLD/NO-GO. A historical date cannot substitute for a failed Branch gate.
precision_guard: Use qualitative or bounded judgments where staff motive/readiness is uncertain; do not manufacture exact probability percentages.
applies_first_to: future Bay of Bengal surface escalation
